# Connect Tag - Technical Tools & IT Solutions Hub

> Information about technical tools, developers utilities, and IT services provided by Connect Tag.

## Core Technical Tools

### Telecom & Internet
- [IMEI & TAC Checker](https://connecttag.org/tools/telecom/imei-checker/): Advanced tool to verify device identity, manufacturer, and technical specifications.
- [Internet Speed Test](https://connecttag.org/tools/telecom/speed-test/): Real-time measurement of download, upload, and ping for local and global connections.
- [Yemen 4G Modems Guide](https://connecttag.org/tools/telecom/modems/): Detailed specifications and settings for Yemen 4G approved devices.
- [Telecom Companies Directory](https://connecttag.org/tools/telecom/company/): Quick access to services, codes, and internet packages for Yemeni providers.

### Developer Utilities
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://connecttag.org/tools/web/json-formatter/): Beautify, minify, and validate JSON structures for app development.
- [JWT Debugger](https://connecttag.org/tools/web/jwt-debugger/): Decode, verify, and generate JSON Web Tokens (HS256).
- [Android Permissions Generator](https://connecttag.org/tools/mobile/android-permissions/): Visual selector to generate AndroidManifest.xml permission codes.
- [RegEx Tester](https://connecttag.org/tools/web/regex-tester/): Test and analyze Regular Expressions with full Arabic language support.
- [Deep Link Generator](https://connecttag.org/tools/mobile/deep-link-generator/): Create and test mobile app deep links (intent:// and https://).

### Security & Privacy
- [Crypto Toolbox](https://connecttag.org/tools/security/crypto-toolbox/): Secure AES encryption, Base64 encoding, and SHA/MD5 hashing.
- [EXIF Metadata Remover](https://connecttag.org/tools/security/exif-remover/): Clean private data (GPS, Device Info) from images before sharing.
- [Privacy Policy Generator](https://connecttag.org/tools/security/privacy-generator/): Generate professional legal documents for apps and websites.

### Finance & Specialized Calculators
- [Zakat Calculator](https://connecttag.org/tools/finance/zakat-calculator/): Calculate Zakat for cash, gold, and silver based on live nisab values.
- [Electrical Unit Converter](https://connecttag.org/tools/energy/unit-converter/): Convert between Watts, Amps, Volts, and Horsepower for solar systems.
- [Solar Energy Calculator](https://connecttag.org/tools/energy/solar-calculator/): Design and size home solar power systems based on appliances load.

### Content & Design
- [Word & Character Counter](https://connecttag.org/tools/misc/word-counter/): Analyze text length and clean Arabic content (remove diacritics/spaces).
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://connecttag.org/tools/design/color-extractor/): Extract Hex/RGB codes from any uploaded image or logo.

## Main Services
- **Web & Mobile Development**: Professional solutions using Flutter, Jetpack Compose, and modern web frameworks.
- **Telecom Solutions**: Infrastructure and technical support for internet subscribers.
- **Cybersecurity Services**: Digital privacy auditing and data protection strategies.
- **Digital Marketing**: Strategic growth and online presence optimization.
